permit-process.title: Whose process?
permit-process.prompt: Choose the process you must follow for a 20 m tower here.

config.scene: Your town has no antenna consultation process of its own.

permit-process.success: No local process, so ISED's default process applies: written notice and a 30-day comment period.

permit-height.title: How tall without consultation?
permit-height.prompt: Lower the tower to the tallest height that's still excluded.

config.scene: This town's process has no extra exemptions, so ISED's exclusion applies.

hints: ISED excludes amateur antenna structures under 15 m.
permit-height.success: Just under 15 m: below ISED's exclusion height, so no consultation is needed.
